# Plan Review

## Summary
Before an agent starts a long or expensive task, it shows the steps it intends to take as an editable list. The person can reword, reorder, remove or add steps, ask for a different plan, and then approve. Nothing runs until they do, and once approved the plan locks and becomes the record of what the agent was asked to do.

## When to use
- Agent runs that are slow, costly or hard to undo: building an app, generating a deck, a multi-source research run, a data migration.
- Tasks where the agent's interpretation can easily diverge from what was meant, so the cheapest moment to correct it is before any work.
- Contexts where people are accountable for what the agent does and need to sign off on it.

## When not to use
- Quick tasks where a wrong start costs seconds. Showing a plan for every request adds friction; show it above a cost or time threshold.
- Showing progress once the run has started — use Task List, which takes over from the approved plan.
- Approving one specific tool call — use Tool Approval.
- Gathering missing preferences — use Clarifying Questions first, then show the plan.

## Anatomy
- Header: title, a note that nothing runs until approval, an optional estimate, and an "Edited" tag once the plan has been changed.
- Step rows: a drag handle, a step number, the step text (click to edit) and a remove button.
- Footer: Add step, New plan, and the primary "Approve & run".
- Approved state: the plan locks, numbers fill in, and the footer confirms the agent is working.

## Behavior
- Steps can be dragged by their handle; with the keyboard, Alt+↑/↓ moves the focused step, Enter edits it, Delete removes it.
- Editing happens inline; Enter or leaving the field saves, Escape cancels, and clearing a step removes it.
- Add step appends an empty row in edit mode.
- New plan asks the agent for a fresh plan; the list dims and controls lock until it arrives, and edits to the old plan are discarded.
- Approve trims empty steps, locks the list and hands the final steps to the agent, which should follow them as written — if it has to deviate, it should say so in the Task List or trace.

## Content guidelines
- One outcome per step, as an imperative phrase: "Draft a 5-slide summary deck".
- Keep plans to three to seven steps; group detail inside steps rather than listing every tool call.
- Put the cost or time estimate in the header so people weigh the plan against it.
- Say plainly that nothing has run yet: "Nothing runs until you approve."

## Accessibility
- Steps are a list; each row is focusable with an accessible name including its position ("Step 2 of 4: …") and a description of the keyboard commands.
- Reordering has a keyboard path (Alt+arrow keys) as well as dragging, and moves are announced through a polite live region ("Moved to position 3 of 4").
- Remove and edit are reachable without a mouse; the remove button stays visible on touch screens.
- The approved state is announced as a status.

## Related patterns
- **Task List** — Use it as well; it shows progress through the approved plan once the agent starts.
- **Tool Approval** — Use it instead to approve a single action rather than a whole plan.
- **Clarifying Questions** — Use it as well, before the plan, when key details are missing.
- **Cost Estimate** — Use it as well when the plan's price should be weighed before approval.
- **Procedure Builder** — Use it instead for reusable procedures people author, rather than a one-off plan the agent proposes.

## Default implementation (Tailwind v4 + Radix + Motion)

This is the catalogue's own reference implementation — use it verbatim when the
host project has no established design system, or when the user asks for
"the demoed look." When the host project has its own design system, treat
this code as a translation reference: keep every rule from the spec above
(Anatomy, Behavior, Content guidelines, Accessibility) and re-express the
markup, styling, and motion using that system's own components/tokens
instead of copying these Tailwind classes or the Motion API.

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, Reorder, useDragControls } from "motion/react";
import { Check, GripVertical, Plus, RotateCcw, X } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface PlanStep {
  id: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface PlanReviewProps {
  title?: string;
  steps: PlanStep[];
  /** Rough cost or duration of running the plan ("~6 min · 40 credits"). */
  estimate?: string;
  onApprove: (steps: PlanStep[]) => void;
  /** Asks the agent for a fresh plan. */
  onRegenerate?: () => Promise<PlanStep[]>;
  approveLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

type Phase = "review" | "regenerating" | "approved";

export function PlanReview({
  title = "Here's my plan",
  steps: initialSteps,
  estimate,
  onApprove,
  onRegenerate,
  approveLabel = "Approve & run",
  className,
}: PlanReviewProps) {
  const [steps, setSteps] = React.useState(initialSteps);
  // What "Edited" compares against: the agent's latest plan.
  const [baseline, setBaseline] = React.useState(initialSteps);
  const [phase, setPhase] = React.useState<Phase>("review");
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = React.useState("");
  const counter = React.useRef(0);
  const listRef = React.useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);
  const keysId = React.useId();

  const changed = JSON.stringify(steps) !== JSON.stringify(baseline);
  const locked = phase !== "review";

  function update(id: string, text: string) {
    setSteps((s) => s.map((step) => (step.id === id ? { ...step, text } : step)));
  }

  function remove(id: string) {
    setSteps((s) => s.filter((step) => step.id !== id));
    setAnnouncement("Step removed");
  }

  function add() {
    const id = `new-${++counter.current}`;
    setSteps((s) => [...s, { id, text: "" }]);
    setEditingId(id);
  }

  function move(id: string, by: -1 | 1) {
    const i = steps.findIndex((step) => step.id === id);
    const j = i + by;
    if (i < 0 || j < 0 || j >= steps.length) return;
    const next = [...steps];
    [next[i], next[j]] = [next[j], next[i]];
    setSteps(next);
    setAnnouncement(`Moved to position ${j + 1} of ${steps.length}`);
    // Keep keyboard focus on the moved row.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => listRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-step="${id}"]`)?.focus());
  }

  async function regenerate() {
    if (!onRegenerate) return;
    setPhase("regenerating");
    setEditingId(null);
    try {
      const next = await onRegenerate();
      setSteps(next);
      setBaseline(next);
      setAnnouncement("New plan ready");
    } finally {
      setPhase("review");
    }
  }

  function approve() {
    const clean = steps.map((s) => ({ ...s, text: s.text.trim() })).filter((s) => s.text);
    setSteps(clean);
    setEditingId(null);
    setPhase("approved");
    onApprove(clean);
  }

  return (
    <section className={cn("w-full rounded-2xl bg-card ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10", className)} aria-label="Plan review">
      <header className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-4 pt-4 pb-2">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">{phase === "approved" ? "Plan approved" : title}</h3>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {phase === "approved"
              ? `Running ${steps.length} steps${estimate ? ` · ${estimate}` : ""}`
              : `Nothing runs until you approve.${estimate ? ` Estimated ${estimate}.` : ""}`}
          </p>
        </div>
        {changed && phase === "review" && (
          <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground bg-muted">Edited</span>
        )}
      </header>

      <Reorder.Group
        ref={listRef}
        as="ul"
        axis="y"
        values={steps}
        onReorder={setSteps}
        aria-label="Plan steps"
        className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1 px-2 transition-opacity", phase === "regenerating" && "opacity-40")}
      >
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {steps.map((step, i) => (
            <Row
              key={step.id}
              step={step}
              index={i}
              total={steps.length}
              locked={locked}
              keysId={keysId}
              editing={editingId === step.id}
              onEdit={() => setEditingId(step.id)}
              onDone={(text) => {
                if (text.trim()) update(step.id, text.trim());
                else remove(step.id);
                setEditingId(null);
              }}
              onRemove={() => remove(step.id)}
              onMove={(by) => move(step.id, by)}
            />
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </Reorder.Group>

      <span className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">
        {announcement}
      </span>
      <span id={keysId} className="sr-only">
        Enter to edit, Alt plus arrow keys to move, Delete to remove.
      </span>

      <footer className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t px-4 py-3">
        {phase === "approved" ? (
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground" role="status">
            <Check className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
            Approved — the agent is working through these steps.
          </span>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={add}
                disabled={locked}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                Add step
              </button>
              {onRegenerate && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={regenerate}
                  disabled={locked}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className={cn("size-3.5", phase === "regenerating" && "animate-spin [animation-direction:reverse]")} aria-hidden />
                  {phase === "regenerating" ? "Rethinking…" : "New plan"}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={approve}
              disabled={locked || steps.every((s) => !s.text.trim())}
              className="rounded-xl bg-foreground px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-background transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              {approveLabel}
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
}

function Row({
  step,
  index,
  total,
  locked,
  keysId,
  editing,
  onEdit,
  onDone,
  onRemove,
  onMove,
}: {
  step: PlanStep;
  index: number;
  total: number;
  locked: boolean;
  keysId: string;
  editing: boolean;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDone: (text: string) => void;
  onRemove: () => void;
  onMove: (by: -1 | 1) => void;
}) {
  const controls = useDragControls();
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(step.text);

  return (
    <Reorder.Item
      value={step}
      dragListener={false}
      dragControls={controls}
      initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto" }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
      className="group relative list-none"
    >
      <div
        data-step={step.id}
        tabIndex={locked || editing ? -1 : 0}
        aria-label={`Step ${index + 1} of ${total}: ${step.text || "empty"}`}
        aria-describedby={locked ? undefined : keysId}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (locked || editing || e.target !== e.currentTarget) return;
          if (e.altKey && e.key === "ArrowUp") {
            e.preventDefault();
            onMove(-1);
          } else if (e.altKey && e.key === "ArrowDown") {
            e.preventDefault();
            onMove(1);
          } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
            e.preventDefault();
            setDraft(step.text);
            onEdit();
          } else if (e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") {
            e.preventDefault();
            onRemove();
          }
        }}
        className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-card px-2 py-2 outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring [.group:hover_&]:bg-muted/50"
      >
        {!locked && (
          <button
            type="button"
            tabIndex={-1}
            aria-hidden
            onPointerDown={(e) => controls.start(e)}
            className="mt-0.5 cursor-grab touch-none text-muted-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground active:cursor-grabbing"
          >
            <GripVertical className="size-4" />
          </button>
        )}
        <span
          className={cn(
            "mt-px flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium tabular-nums bg-muted",
            locked && "border-foreground bg-foreground text-background"
          )}
          aria-hidden
        >
          {index + 1}
        </span>

        {editing ? (
          <input
            autoFocus
            value={draft}
            onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
            onBlur={() => onDone(draft)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") onDone(draft);
              if (e.key === "Escape") onDone(step.text);
            }}
            aria-label={`Edit step ${index + 1}`}
            placeholder="Describe the step"
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring bg-muted focus:bg-background"
          />
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            tabIndex={-1}
            disabled={locked}
            onClick={() => {
              setDraft(step.text);
              onEdit();
            }}
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 cursor-text text-left text-sm text-pretty disabled:cursor-default"
          >
            {step.text}
          </button>
        )}

        {!locked && !editing && (
          <button
            type="button"
            tabIndex={-1}
            onClick={onRemove}
            aria-label={`Remove step ${index + 1}`}
            className="flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-opacity hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground [@media(hover:hover)]:opacity-0 [@media(hover:hover)]:group-hover:opacity-100"
          >
            <X className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </Reorder.Item>
  );
}
```
